req.title: Login sets session on success
req.statement: The system shall set session['user_id'] and redirect to / when POST /auth/login receives a matching username and password.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-008 requires that POST /auth/login with valid credentials returns HTTP 302 to '/' and sets session['user_id']. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid username+password yields 302 and correct session; (2) negative NEG — wrong password yields no redirect and no session; (3) negative NEG — unknown username yields no redirect; (4) BVA — first user in DB (id=1, Rahul/stone) and last user (id=5, James/river) both succeed; (5) DT — all four combinations of username/password correctness. Session inspection uses Flask's test client session_transaction(). Exact status codes and Location headers are asserted to catch operator/constant mutations.

tests.name: test_login_valid_credentials_sets_session_and_redirects
preconditions: Database contains user id=1 username='Rahul' password='stone'
App is in TESTING mode with a fresh temp database
trace: R-FLASKR-008: success path sets session and redirects to /
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user (username, password) VALUES (?, ?)",
               ('Rahul', generate_password_hash('stone')))
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_login_valid_credentials_sets_session_and_redirects():
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert sess['user_id'] == 1

tests.name: test_login_boundary_first_and_last_user_ids
preconditions: Database contains user id=1 (Rahul/stone) and user id=5 (James/river)
trace: R-FLASKR-008: boundary user ids (min=1, max=5) both produce correct session values
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    for uname, pwd in [('Rahul','stone'),('Anjali','cloud'),('Ishaan','stone'),('Diya','cloud'),('James','river')]:
        db.execute("INSERT INTO user (username, password) VALUES (?, ?)",
                   (uname, generate_password_hash(pwd)))
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_login_boundary_first_and_last_user_ids():
    r1 = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    assert r1.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert sess['user_id'] == 1
    r2 = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    assert r2.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert sess['user_id'] == 5

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user (username, password) VALUES (?, ?)",
               ('Anjali', generate_password_hash('cloud')))
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_login_decision_table_all_credential_combinations():
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' in sess
        assert sess['user_id'] == 1
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Anjali', 'password': 'badpass'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Incorrect password.' in r.data
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Nobody', 'password': 'cloud'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Nobody', 'password': 'badpass'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess

preconditions: Client starts with no session (unauthenticated state)

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    for uname, pwd in [('Rahul','stone'),('Anjali','cloud'),('Ishaan','stone')]:
        db.execute("INSERT INTO user (username, password) VALUES (?, ?)",
                   (uname, generate_password_hash(pwd)))
    db.commit()

client = app.test_client()

def test_login_session_transition_unauthenticated_to_authenticated():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Ishaan', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' in sess
        assert sess['user_id'] == 3
